scoring_contract.native_success: not pre_satisfied and the unchanged checker on the post-episode world
scoring_contract.merged_tasks: Native _merge retains multiple user messages but scores only the first TaskSpec in that episode; retain that rule. Supplementary obligation checks are diagnostics, not rewritten native scores.
scoring_contract.value_tracer: Use merit.metrics.memory_utilized on actual executed business tool arguments; distinguish string matching from causal contribution.

matched_conditions: original per-episode sessions; no cross-episode active decision
same initial empty memory per arm
state_policy off; no old State profile

opportunity_audit.cross_episode_amount_updates: Present as durable-memory regression; task reset clears current decision. Not a natural pre-update active-decision adoption opportunity across those episodes.
opportunity_audit.within_turn_version_change: Possible only if Host adopts an older delivered card then actually revises that card; declaration is not forced.
opportunity_audit.same_task_new_observations: Episodes 1 and 2 have two original user messages; each second message concerns a different order. Current decision can be retargeted or retained by Host.
opportunity_audit.query_gap: Only applicable if a genuine unresolved information need is expressed; ordinary arm may rewrite queries.
opportunity_audit.continuous_reuse: Original episode windows contain at most two public messages and change order; do not merge sessions or manufacture N=4/8 prefixes.
